summary: The Index Support Sync notes for 28 September 2026 are a short agenda with no recorded outcomes. Talat listed relaxing the strict global non-overlap rule to allow bounded overlap in region files. Two open questions in the index draft spec were carried over from the previous sync: defining the sort order as a list of field ids, reusing a revamped table sort order definition, and whether to keep the index type field, which the notes' author wants to keep for future index types. The draft index spec pull request was listed for review.
